answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The quill multiplier is published, charged in raven, and karst lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 2 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 2046 identities would post 4909 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
